blinding_guess.why: ServoNode warns users to enable use_intra_process_comms (servo_node.cpp:72-76) yet creates every publisher and subscription with rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS(), whose history is SYSTEM_DEFAULT with depth 0; rclcpp's intra-process path requires keep-last history with non-zero depth, so following the node's own advice can make create_publisher/create_subscription throw.

notes: Package source is snapshot/moveit_ros/moveit_servo (the snapshot is the whole moveit2 tree). All four packet elements are rclcpp APIs this package consumes; none is provided, so declares and not_declared are empty and the four names go into references. The production call sites are in src/servo_node.cpp (built into moveit_servo_lib_ros, CMakeLists.txt:59, registered as component servo_node); demos/cpp_interface/*.cpp, demos/servo_keyboard_input.cpp and tests/*.hpp|cpp also call create_publisher/create_subscription, the tests and cpp demos with rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS(). Port fields msg_type, frame, units, rate and definition_id are null because each element is an API symbol, not a topic: create_publisher is instantiated with trajectory_msgs::msg::JointTrajectory, std_msgs::msg::Float64MultiArray and moveit_msgs::msg::ServoStatus; create_subscription with control_msgs::msg::JointJog, geometry_msgs::msg::TwistStamped and geometry_msgs::msg::PoseStamped. All topic names arrive at run time from parameters (joint_command_in_topic, cartesian_command_in_topic, pose_command_in_topic, command_out_topic, status_topic; defaults in config/servo_parameters.yaml:33-73). QoS: the code fixes rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS() for every pub/sub; that profile (rmw_qos_profile_system_default, per rclcpp/rmw documentation, not in the snapshot) leaves reliability, durability and history at SYSTEM_DEFAULT and depth at RMW_QOS_POLICY_DEPTH_SYSTEM_DEFAULT (0), so the concrete reliability/durability are selected by the RMW implementation's configuration, which is not in the snapshot; recorded as null. No deadline is set. The nominal loop rate is 1/publish_period with publish_period default 0.034 s (servo_parameters.yaml:144-151, servo_node.cpp:295); not recorded as rate_hz because the ports are API symbols. Launch files in the snapshot (launch/demo_ros_api.launch.py:89-101, tests/launch/servo_ros_integration.test.py:75) launch ServoNode as a composable node without extra_arguments setting use_intra_process_comms.
